description_en: Queries all properties of an office network, including the ID, name, status, and creation time
description_zh: 查询办公网络的所有属性，包括ID、名称、状态、创建时间等
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-office-sites --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-type SIMPLE --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --status REGISTERED --security-protection SASE --vpc-id vpc-uf6w8u60n8xbkg5el0000 --account-type SIMPLE --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeOfficeSites

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The account system type of the office network
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络的账号体系类型
parameters.name: office_site_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

最大值：100。    
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The office network ID. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The Network Security Protection Settings of the office network
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络安全防护配置
parameters.name: security_protection

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the office network for shared cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh:
共享型云电脑的办公网络所在的VPC ID。

该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: vpc_id
